name: cgam_cogeneration
title: CGAM cogeneration benchmark (gas turbine + HRSG)
summary: Design-point CGAM problem (Valero et al. 1994) as built in the TESPy test suite: gas turbine with air preheater and HRSG (economiser, drum, evaporator) delivering 14 kg/s of saturated steam at 20 bar and 30 MW net power; the fuel flow follows from the TIT, the air flow from the net power; ideal-gas mixture air/flue gas, Water on the steam side.

authors: Francesco Witte and the TESPy contributors
origin.course: CGAM problem (Valero et al., Energy 19(3) 1994) as built in TESPy test_CGAM_model.py (commit 19425523); reference data tests/test_models/cgam-ebsilon-results.csv

verification.summary: Re-ran the source test (test_CGAM_model.py, TESPy 0.11.3.dev0/CoolProp 8.0.0, throw-away venv) and compared all states, powers and compositions: max rel diff 2.0e-03 (h, s as same-composition differences, as the source test does). Against the Ebsilon table (cgam-ebsilon-results.csv): compressor 29.740 vs 29.6597 MW (2.7e-03), turbine 59.740 vs 59.6597 MW (1.4e-03), max 4.7e-03, card tolerance 5e-03.
verification.reference: TESPy re-run of the source (local snapshot ~/git/tespy commit 19425523, run_cgam.py) and the Ebsilon results table tests/test_models/cgam-ebsilon-results.csv; comparison with work/cgam_cogeneration/compare_refs.py
verification.notes: vs TESPy re-run: max 2.034e-03 on ds[7]-ds[4]. vs Ebsilon: max 4.741e-03 on ds[6]-ds[4] (TESPy's own deviation from Ebsilon is bounded at 5e-03 by the source test); W_comp 2.715e-03, W_turb 1.347e-03. CoolSolve H2O entropy is the third-law NASA value (~3.5 kJ/kg-K above CoolProp HEOS), a constant offset that cancels in all same-composition entropy differences of the model.

history.action: added (T-TRANSLATE of the TESPy CGAM test model, card C-191, inventory row TSP-050); verified against a TESPy re-run and the Ebsilon table of the source test
